column1: # Exact EPathMap map union: reconstructed right topology/value reinsertion versus synchronized PathMap zipper graft.
# Experiment checkpoint: 75ded65bf. Selected general-graft production checkpoint: a6e62b76f.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned.
# Preflight: 68.05% aggregate idle; CPU 8 was 95.68% idle; 49 GiB available memory; zero swap used.
# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -j 4 -p models --bench epathmap_map_join_graft --features epathmap-map-join-differential
# Design: 60 retained paired/interleaved samples after 10 warmups per cell; arm order rotated each repetition; exactly one run.
# Fixture: 2,048 entries per operand; disjoint 64B/4096B values, half overlap, independently equal maps, and unchanged clone-family maps.

# Robustness: Cliff's delta=-1.0; Mann-Whitney p=0.0. Both arms depart from normality; the nonparametric result agrees.
